description: LCIA Formatter is a Python tool for standardising life-cycle impact assessment methods and elementary flows. The Federal LCA Commons README says it obtains source impact data, cleans and maps flows to a common format, and can export CSV, spreadsheet or openLCA JSON-LD files. Users select a supported method and mapping; outputs are aligned impact-factor tables for later assessment. Geographic coverage follows the method and factors chosen. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing, while source methods such as TRACI and ReCiPe retain their own attribution and use conditions. A limitation is that an automated flow match may miss substance, compartment or unit distinctions; the result requires method-specific checks. The tool can prepare impact factors for infrastructure materials and energy-system life-cycle scenarios. The related Brightway catalogue platform is a separate modelling environment. No impact dataset or software package was downloaded.
name: LCIA Formatter impact-data harmonisation
notes: G7 G7-1856. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
